business_scope.primary_industry_name: Global App Store Optimization and Multilingual Organic Search

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa — International Companies Registry, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — English common law tradition (via New Zealand colonial legacy) fused with Samoan customary law principles; offshore international company law governed by the International Companies Act 1987-88, a statutory regime modeled on common-law international business company acts.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Double Tax Agreement between the Independent State of Samoa and the People's Republic of China (signed 2018; in force)
PACER Plus — Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (Samoa ratified 2019; in force 2020)
PICTA — Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (signed 2001; in force for Samoa)
Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Nordic countries and other Global Forum jurisdictions; FATCA IGA with the United States

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (Act No. 11 of 1987-88), as amended, including the International Companies Amendment Act 2015 which mandatorily requires beneficial ownership records for every Samoa International Company; read with the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended) and the AML/CFT Guidelines of the Central Bank of Samoa / Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (SFIU); beneficial ownership and CDD records are filed with the licensed Samoan registered agent and the MCIL International Companies Registry, with onward lawful disclosure to SFIU, Samoa Police, Customs, Revenue and foreign regulators on exchange-of-information requests.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — the beneficial ownership register of a Samoa International Company is not open to public inspection; it is maintained confidentially by the licensed registered agent and the International Companies Registry and is disclosed only to competent domestic authorities (SFIU, Revenue, Customs, Police) and to foreign regulators under lawful mutual assistance, TIEA or FATCA channels.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport of each proposed director, shareholder and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport-issuing authority or licensed notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the origin country is an Apostille Contracting Party (accepted in practice by MCIL and licensed registered agents); otherwise consular legalization via the Samoa Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade or nearest Samoan consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within the last three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank issuer, notarized by a public notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR consular legalization via Samoa MFAT; document must be re-notarized if older than 90 days

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or certified extract from the company registry for each corporate shareholder or corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR consular legalization; multi-level federal states require dual legalization through both the issuing registry and the central foreign ministry before Samoan acceptance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter (good standing) from the account-holding bank of each beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank of the UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank-to-bank AML correspondence countersigned by the Samoan registered agent; if externally notarized, then Hague Apostille OR consular legalization applies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized statutory declaration of source of funds and source of wealth of each UBO (AML/CFT CDD form)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary or licensed Samoan registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Executed before the Samoan registered agent or a notary; no foreign apostille required when executed in Samoa; foreign-executed declarations require notarization plus Hague Apostille OR consular legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every proposed director, shareholder, UBO, authorized signatory and the licensed registered agent against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN List, the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Samoa's domestic terrorism and suspicious activity listings under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007, and international PEP databases; enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons (foreign, domestic and international-organization PEPs), requiring source-of-wealth verification, senior management approval and ongoing transaction monitoring; re-screening occurs at least annually and upon any trigger event such as adverse media, sanctions designation, suspicious transaction report or material ownership change. Given the Low_Risk_Standard AML tier of the App Growth Agency model, standard CDD applies with periodic transaction monitoring over Wise B2B and Payoneer rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — International Companies Registry desk, Apia; there is no standalone direct-to-public web portal for International Company name reservation — name clearance is submitted in writing or via the licensed Samoan registered agent's e-filing channel and is processed by the Registry within 2-3 business days.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name must be expressed entirely in Roman/Latin script; Chinese characters, Samoan diacritics and non-Latin alphabets cannot be registered as the legal company name. A non-Roman brand may be used as a foreign-language trade name or trademark but the legal name must be a Romanized transliteration. The name must end with a permitted suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.' or 'Pty Ltd'; the Registrar may require an English translation of any foreign-word token and may refuse names that are identical or confusingly similar to any existing domestic Samoa company or registered International Company.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'Bank', 'Banking', 'Credit', 'Trust', 'Trustee', 'Nominee' — require a banking or trust licence under Central Bank of Samoa legislation
'Fund', 'Mutual Fund', 'Collective Investment', 'Securities', 'Broker', 'Capital Markets' — require MCIL or Central Bank approval
'Fiduciary', 'Management Company' — require a licensed registered agent or trust company licence
'Government', 'State', 'National', 'Royal', 'Imperial', 'Federal', 'Republic', 'Sovereign', 'Public Authority' — require prior Samoan Cabinet or Ministerial consent
'Samoa', 'Samoan', 'Apia' or any name implying Samoan government patronage — require Ministerial exemption
Any name that is identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered company, an International Company on the register, or an entity on the protected names list
Any name the Registrar deems offensive, obscene, scandalous, misleading or contrary to public order, and any name implying a regulated entity type inconsistent with the actual business scope
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A 30-day reservation may be extended in further 30-day blocks upon written request to the Registry before expiry, accompanied by the applicable fee and provided no conflicting application has been lodged. Upon rejection, the registered agent receives the Registrar's written refusal with reasons. The proposed incorporator may file a written review application with the Assistant Registrar — International Companies within 14 days of the refusal, stating the legal basis for eligibility and distinguishing the proposed name from conflicting registrations. If the internal review is dismissed, the applicant may appeal within 21 days to the Chief Executive Officer of MCIL; a further appeal lies to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour, whose decision is subject to judicial review by the Supreme Court of Samoa within 30 days of the Ministerial determination. A fresh reservation may also be filed without prejudice using an amended spelling or brand form.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: The statutory registered office of a Samoa International Company must be a physical address in Samoa maintained by a licensed registered agent; a virtual mailbox or shell address cannot satisfy the statutory registered-office obligation, and the IC must be able to receive service of process and government correspondence at that physical address. Because International Companies are prohibited from carrying on business with Samoan residents and from owning Samoan real estate, the operating team of the App Growth Agency may work fully remotely outside Samoa; a virtual office for the SEO/ASO delivery teams in China, Southeast Asia or elsewhere is permitted and does not create Samoan corporate tax residency, while the Samoan registered agent remains the legal service address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — approximately 5% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection for a Low_Risk_Standard, license-free, tax-exempt International Company with no Samoan operational footprint. The licensed registered agent's premises in Apia are subject to regular annual compliance inspections by MCIL and the SFIU; the International Company itself is inspected only on risk-based triggers such as adverse media, a sanctions hit, a suspicious transaction report, or defective 25% UBO threshold documentation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation fee (International Companies Registry)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — International Companies Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies Fees Regulations / prevailing registry schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation fee on authorized share capital up to USD 50,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff calculated on the authorized capital band

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Year-1 licensed registered agent fee (statutory registered office and annual filing liaison)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Samoan international company registered agent (private professional firm)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a low-risk standard International Company (market band USD 450–750 per annum)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT client due diligence, PEP and sanctions screening, UBO register compilation and filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / Central Bank of Samoa SFIU interface
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for complete CDD pack, PEP/sanctions screening, UBO register preparation and MCIL filing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and/or consular legalization of UBO identity and address document bundle (per director or UBO)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in origin country plus competent foreign ministry or consular authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Usual notarial and legalization fee schedule of the origin jurisdiction (estimate; varies by country)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank reference letter processing and institutional AML verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bank fee schedule for reference letters

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and handling of original certificates from the Apia registry to overseas directors
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for international priority document courier

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 2017 (Samoa), as amended — Part 2 (Incorporation and Powers), Part 4 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), Part 5 (Directors and Officers); subsidiary application of the Companies Act 2001 where expressly adopted
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued upon registration of the notarized Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; nominal issued share capital (commonly US$1 or 1,000 non-voting qualifying shares) is permitted; no escrow or deposit account requirement for an International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the Incorporator, that the Company be and is hereby incorporated under the International Companies Act 2017, and that the subscriber shares set forth in the Memorandum of Association be allotted and issued to the founding subscriber against par value credited as fully paid. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be and is hereby fixed at the office of the registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and that such agent is authorized to hold the office, maintain statutory registers, and accept legal process on the Company's behalf. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Director Name] be appointed sole Director and [Secretary Name] be appointed Corporate Secretary for the first term, with authority to execute contracts, open bank accounts, and engage professional advisors; and that the seal, certificates, and corporate records be adopted as authentic.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Registration Unit, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed SIFA registered agent to submit a name reservation request for up to three proposed corporate names, each ending in 'Limited' or 'IC'. The registrar verifies that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity and does not suggest prohibited activity. No physical attendance is required; processing is through the agent's e-filing channel.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (primary and two alternates)
Brief statement of principal business purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged, submit an amended reservation with alternative names; if objection is raised by a third party, file a written response with evidence of non-confusion or revert to an alternate name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Samoa) with oversight by licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles in English, setting out the company name, registered office address in Samoa, share structure, permitted purposes (including digital marketing, app store optimization, and SEO localization services), and minimum of one director and one secretary. The incorporating subscriber executes the documents before a notary; the registered agent counter-signs its consent to act.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar queries any clause (e.g., restrictive purpose wording), revise and re-execute the affected page by supplementary notarized instrument before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with SIFA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits Form IC-1 together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles, the agent's consent, and the government filing fee. The registrar reviews the application for legal compliance, capital adequacy, and confirmation that the activity will be carried on outside Samoa. The application is filed online via the SIFA portal and approved administratively.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On requisition, respond in writing within 14 days, correct administrative defects, pay any additional assessment, and re-submit; if the application is rejected, file a fresh application with revised documentation or apply to the Registrar for review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and confirms the company's registered office and agent. The registered agent compiles the corporate kit containing the certificate, sealed memorandum and articles, share certificates, and first statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of registered Memorandum and Articles
Statutory registers of members, directors, and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains errors or the seal/certificates are defective, request a corrected certificate through the registered agent and pay any nominal replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Governance Formalities and Bank Account Readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent (SIFA-licensed) and First Board of Directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting by unanimous written resolution: adopt the share allotment, confirm director and secretary appointments, adopt the registered office and agent, authorize execution of banking agreements, and approve the KYC/AML pack for Wise B2B and Payoneer account opening. Maintain registers at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
Director passport, proof of address, and source of funds
Business plan or client engagement evidence for bank due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank or payment rail KYC diligence is unsatisfied, amend the board resolution to supply supplementary evidence, appoint an additional director or compliance officer, or procure a bank reference letter from the registered agent.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — applicable only if a physical commercial office is subsequently opened in Samoa; no industrial board license is required for a purely offshore digital services agency.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no industrial or manufacturing operating permit. An optional MCIL Business Licence is required solely for a physical office; the offshore International Company may otherwise operate without a sectoral license.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA) within the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Registration-only category — office-based and IT service activities produce no significant environmental impact; a full EIA Report is not required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process discharges anticipated; if an office is occupied, compliance with the Samoa Water Authority general trade-waste discharge standards and applicable electronic-waste disposal rules for IT equipment is required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) for any occupied office premises; structural clearance from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure for leased space; no hazardous materials handling is involved. For remote or home-office operation, no clearance is required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), Ministry of Finance, Government of Samoa; official portal: https://sra.gov.ws with SRA Online e-Services for TIN, VAGST and e-filing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned International Company must obtain a Samoa Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) by submitting the prescribed TIN application form to SRA, accompanied by certified copy of the International Companies Act 1987 certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, certified passport copies of directors/shareholders, proof of registered agent or office address in Samoa, and a written authorisation to the resident registered agent. Applications may be filed online via SRA e-Services or at SRA Apia head office; SRA issues the TIN within 3-10 business days, subject to verification of beneficial ownership and AML/KYC clearance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election or hybrid mismatch election exists in Samoa. An International Company may elect under the International Companies Act 1987 to register as a domestic (resident) company, irrevocably converting to full Samoa tax residency and losing the statutory tax-exempt status; otherwise the IC remains a tax-exempt non-resident entity. A separate VAGST registration election is available only if the IC makes taxable supplies within Samoa, which is generally prohibited for a licensed IC; no passthrough or flow-through entity election is recognised under the Income Tax Act 2007.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2008 (Samoa)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 per annum of taxable turnover; compulsory registration applies once annual taxable supplies exceed this threshold, and voluntary registration is available for persons making taxable supplies in Samoa below the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API connectivity, or digital stamping requirement is presently mandated by SRA. Registered VAGST persons must issue compliant VAGST tax invoices and credit notes in the prescribed format containing all statutory fields; electronic filing and payment of VAGST returns is mandatory through SRA Online e-Services, but there is no government pre-clearance or real-time invoice reporting system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating under VAGST applies to (i) exported goods physically removed from Samoa within the prescribed timeframe and supported by customs export records, and (ii) services supplied to a non-resident recipient outside Samoa where the benefit of the services is received offshore and the supply does not relate directly to land or goods situated in Samoa. The International Company's offshore App Store Optimization, multilingual SEO and localization agency services supplied solely to non-residents, invoiced in foreign currency and paid from abroad, are eligible for 0% VAGST as exported services or are otherwise outside the scope of Samoa VAGST, provided no taxable supply occurs within Samoa.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic CusDEC lodged with Samoa Customs)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods (where applicable)
Inward Remittance Certificate, bank credit advice, or SWIFT MT103 evidencing foreign-currency payment received from the non-resident client
Executed service agreement or detailed sales invoice demonstrating the non-resident status of the client and offshore delivery of services
Samoa Certificate of Origin or VAT/GST exemption certificate where required by the destination jurisdiction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SRA auditors scrutinise export zero-rating claims against the full documentation bundle; failure to maintain adequate export evidence triggers retrospective clawback of unlawfully claimed VAGST input credits and repayment of missed output tax, plus penalty tax of 100% to 150% of the shortfall and an additional interest charge under the Tax Administration Act 2012. Knowingly false or fraudulent export zero-rating documentation constitutes an offence punishable by criminal fines and imprisonment, with directors, beneficial owners, and the resident registered agent jointly and severally liable for assessed amounts.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), Exchange Control Division
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Current account transactions are generally convertible for bona fide trade and service payments upon documentation. Capital account transactions, including inbound equity injections and foreign share transfers, require prior CBS Exchange Control approval or must be effected through an Authorized Dealer. Profit remittance is permitted subject to submission of audited financial statements, tax clearance certificates, and a remittance application evidencing foreign investment registration. Practical hurdles include documentary back-log, limited local correspondent banking relationships, and CBS scrutiny of intra-group payments for which transfer-pricing documentation may be mandated.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters must repatriate full export proceeds through an Authorized Dealer within 90 days from the date of shipment. mandatory conversion ratio is 100% of the WST-equivalent export proceeds, unless a written exemption is granted by the CBS for proceeds retained in an approved foreign currency account. The exporter is required to provide a bill of lading, commercial invoice, customs export declaration, and bank credit advice confirming inward receipt prior to release of conversion.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Wise B2B and Payoneer are not licensed as banks or electronic money institutions in Samoa and cannot serve as the primary regulated clearing rail for settlement in Samoan tala or as local receivables accounts. They may function only as ancillary client collection or vendor payout channels, provided underlying transactions are recorded in the primary Samoan bank account and identified purpose codes are supplied. CBS exchange control rules require all Samoa-sourced and export-related flows to route through an Authorized Dealer.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of at least one director is generally mandated for the initial KYC interview at the bank’s Apia branch. Remote opening may be considered on a case-by-case basis for existing International Companies arranged through a Samoa-licensed corporate service provider, subject to a video interview with the compliance officer, notarized certified passport copies, and original bank reference letters. Foreign directors who do not travel to Samoa must provide a notarized appointment of an authorized local signatory or corporate director. The bank may require the registered agent to attest to the identity of all beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore non-resident ownership structure with multiple intermediate holding entities
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified structure chart covering all intermediate entities, an up-to-date register of directors and shareholders, UBO declaration identifying individuals with >10% ownership, source of wealth statements, and a professional introduction letter from the Samoa-licensed international company service provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Permissible business activity not immediately obvious from entity name or ISIC code classification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed service agreement between the Samoa International Company and its global clients, together with app-store payout statements, ASO/SEO campaign performance reports, and a statutory declaration by the natural person director describing the digital-growth agency business model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face identification of foreign directors and ultimate beneficial owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled passport copies, independent electronic KYC verification reports from a recognized vendor, bank references from the director's primary domestic bank, and a sealed video-interview recording retained by the Samoa corporate service provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Prospective cross-border wire activity to multiple vendor jurisdictions inconsistent with declared low-risk profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copies of vendor contracts, itemized invoices, localization project briefs, and an annual cash-flow forecast showing commercial rationale, plus a statement confirming no sanctioned jurisdiction parties and current sanctions screening results.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected receipt of funds from app-store aggregators and digital advertisement platforms
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apple App Store and Google Play payout or settlement reports, Apple Search Ads and Google Ads invoices, platform-level agreement excerpts, and a letter from the Samoan tax or corporate registrar confirming no local economic substance or licensing impediment for such digital receipts.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity subscription or shareholder loan proceeds must be remitted via SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the remitter’s bank to a CBS Authorized Dealer in Samoa using purpose code 'FDI – Equity Capital Contribution' or 'Intercompany Debt – Shareholder Subordinated Loan'. The bank requires a Board Resolution, updated register of shareholders, signed subscription agreement, and a completed CBS Exchange Control Form EX-1. For a Samoa International Company, capital contributions may be held in a designated Capital Escrow Account pending business use; the contribution must match the exact remitter name and the stated corporate purpose, and the bank will verify that no third-party payment instruction is hidden within the transfer narrative.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements are cleared through SWIFT MT103 for direct vendor payments and through Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600) for contract-backed import or service obligations. Local currency (WST) disbursements require settlement through the Samoa automated clearing house; foreign-currency disbursements are processed by the Authorized Dealer with supporting invoice, contract, and CBS form T/I for trade and non-trade payments. Vendor payments routed to Wise B2B or Payoneer should be structured as separate MT103 wires with client-specific remittance info, ensuring the Samoa bank’s beneficiary account is named as the same legal entity for AML traceability. The agency must ensure that outbound disbursements are not used for settlements with sanctioned entities and that CBS reporting thresholds for transactions above WST 100,000 are observed.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Bank-issued WST/USD, WST/AUD, and WST/NZD deliverable forward contracts up to 12 months, available only through ANZ Bank Samoa or BSP with a CBS-approved underlying exposure declaration.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for exotic or offshore currency pairs, confined to USD and AUD referencing sources, structured through the bank’s offshore treasury desk and requiring hedging-scheme approval when in excess of USD 500,000.
Cross-currency swaps for WST-linked principal flows, permissible solely with an Authorized Dealer under a CBS Exchange Control exemption and only where a matched commercial exposure is demonstrated.

Interest-rate and FX options are generally restricted; plain-vanilla European FX options may be granted for hedging service receipts where the premium is funded from operating cash flow and settled through the Samoan banking channel.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June or the Registrar's renewal invoice date at the company's incorporation anniversary, whichever is stated in the renewal notice.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs a penalty of USD 25 per month or part-month; if the fee is unpaid for 90 days after the due date, the Registrar may strike the International Company off the Register, with restoration requiring payment of arrears, penalties, and a restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not applicable; no filing with the Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No statutory deadline; Samoa International Companies are not required to file an annual return or audited financial statements.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No penalty applies for non-filing of accounts; the company must nevertheless remain current on its annual government fee and maintain its statutory books.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO and AML Compliance Refresh Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (AML/CFT compliance file under the Samoa Money Laundering and Prevention of Terrorism Financing Act 2018)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the company's anniversary date, and immediately after any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The registered agent may decline to execute client instructions, report to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, or resign after 30 days' written notice; failure to appoint a replacement agent may trigger strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Register Audit and Secretarial Certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent / Corporate Secretary internal statutory file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At each company anniversary, coinciding with the annual fee renewal process.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or incomplete registers may result in fines against the company and each defaulting officer; the Registrar may also order rectification and treat continuing non-compliance as an AML control failure.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a Samoa International Company; no statutory audit is triggered by revenue, assets, employees, or public-interest criteria. The Registrar may order an inspection or audit only in exceptional enforcement circumstances and must do so in writing.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Not prescribed by the International Companies Act 1987. When financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS or IFRS for SMEs should be used to present a true and fair view, but such statements are not filed with any Samoa government authority.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Samoa does not maintain a public UBO register. The licensed registered agent must keep an internal UBO record and perform an annual AML review under the Samoa Money Laundering and Prevention of Terrorism Financing Act 2018. The company must confirm on each anniversary that the register of members is accurate and disclose any share transfers during the year; a transfer is effective only when recorded in the Register of Members, and the registered agent must complete AML verification before accepting the transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit required; voluntary audit typically USD 3,000-6,000 for a simple agency holding structure.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (International Company exemption under Section 166, International Companies Act 1987, as amended; standard resident corporate rate otherwise 25%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full tax exemption from income tax, stamp duty, and capital gains for International Companies; only fixed annual government fee based on authorized capital; standard resident companies are subject to 25% corporate income tax

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return required for International Companies; annual compliance is effected via the International Company Annual Return and Renewal filing submitted through the registered agent to the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and the Registrar of International Companies (MCIL e-Registry)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the incorporation anniversary date (within 60 days of each anniversary; actual date stated on the Certificate of Incorporation)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique company number assigned at incorporation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact IC number; verify against Certificate of Incorporation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the International Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Name must match the Certificate of Incorporation exactly, including any 'Limited' suffix

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A local address maintained by the licensed registered agent is required; PO Box alone is insufficient

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licensing details of the Samoan registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be licensed under the International Companies Act; overseas directors cannot act as the registered agent

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of authorized capital and number/class of issued shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State denominations in USD; minimum capital is not required but must not be nil

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, addresses, and nationalities of all directors and beneficial shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals are permitted; provide certified passports and proof of residential address

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of ultimate beneficial owners to SIFA under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) framework
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory for AML compliance; non-disclosure triggers suspension of the company's registration

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the company has conducted no taxable onshore trading activity and claims the IC exemption
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a brief statement that revenue is derived exclusively from offshore operations; any onshore activity in Samoa surrenders the exemption

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal surcharge of USD 100–500 plus compounding interest at 10% per month or part thereof; continued default for 3 months leads to automatic strike-off from the Register, loss of legal personality, and forfeiture of assets to the State; restoration costs are substantial

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for distributions made by an International Company to any shareholder; by statutory exemption, no withholding tax applies to dividends, distributions, or other returns of capital of an IC
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Treaty relief is generally unnecessary for ICs because distributions are statutorily exempt. If a resident company (not an IC) claims DTA relief, the protocol is: (1) obtain a Samoa Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the Ministry of Revenue; (2) submit the TRC and a Form of Tax Relief Application to the payer; (3) payer applies the reduced treaty withholding rate at source; (4) if tax is over-withheld, seek refund from the Samoa Ministry of Revenue within 3 years. Samoa's principal DTAs are with China (dividends 5% if holding >=10%, otherwise 10%; interest 10%; royalties 10%) and New Zealand (dividends 15% / 5% for >=10% holding; interest 10%; royalties 10%)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rates: interest 15%, royalties 15%, management fees 15% paid to non-residents. Treaty-reduced rates: China 10% for interest and royalties; New Zealand 10% for interest and royalties. ICs remain wholly exempt from these charges on outbound payments

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 (administrative de minimis for cross-border related-party transactions; Samoa TP rules under the Income Tax Act 2012 and Tax Administration Act 2012 apply OECD ALP principles, but no express Local File/Master File monetary threshold is gazetted; ICs are outside the TP regime because they have no taxable income)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable: Samoa's International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 requires every IC engaged in a 'relevant activity' — including holding of intellectual property, distribution and service center businesses, and pure holding companies — to demonstrate substantial economic presence in Samoa. A remote ASO/SEO localization agency classified under relevant services must show: (i) a physical office in Samoa; (ii) a minimum of locally resident employees engaged in core revenue-generating functions; (iii) annual economic substance reporting to SIFA with audited books maintained in Samoa; (iv) board meetings with a quorum of directors physically held in Samoa. Failure results in penalties, exchange-of-information disclosure to foreign tax authorities, and potential strike-off

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Fraudulent Offshore Arrangement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a real, commercially active ASO/SEO localization business through an exempt Samoa International Company while disguising revenue as tax-exempt offshore income; submitting false declarations of non-onshore activity; or structuring the entity purely to evade foreign tax in the beneficial owner's residence jurisdiction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Tax Administration Act 2012 and Crimes Act 2013: civil penalty up to 150% of the tax evaded plus interest at 10% per annum; criminal fines up to WST 50,000 and imprisonment up to 7 years; automatic disclosure to foreign tax authorities under the Common Reporting Standard and Exchange of Information framework
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of corporate veil: directors and ultimate beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for restitution of unpaid tax; imposition of travel bans, asset freezing orders, and extradition proceedings; personal imprisonment for up to 7 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a letterbox IC with no office, no employees, no local books and no board meetings in Samoa, while benefiting from the tax-exempt regime and treaty protections; failing to file the annual economic substance return or reporting zero substance to SIFA
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Economic Substance Act 2019 and International Companies Act 1987: fixed penalty up to WST 10,000 per violation; daily default penalty up to WST 1,000; maximum aggregate fines up to USD 500,000 or WST 10,000,000 for aggravated non-compliance; automatic exchange of non-compliant entity data with foreign tax authorities; administrative strike-off of the company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face disqualification orders from serving as directors of any Samoan company for up to 5 years; personal fines of up to USD 250,000 where willful non-compliance is proven; directors' personal assets may be reached for fines unpaid by the company

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file accurate beneficial ownership data with SIFA; concealing the identity of the true owner of the IC; screening in proceeds derived from fraudulent app installs, click fraud, or payment-rail abuse via Wise B2B or Payoneer
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2000 (as amended) and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act: fines up to WST 200,000; imprisonment up to 7 years; freezing and forfeiture of funds held in any payment rail; referral to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit for criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors named in criminal proceedings, subject to personal travel restrictions and passport surrender while under investigation; personal liability for the value of laundered assets; disqualification from holding financial accounts in Samoa; imprisonment of up to 7 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Continuing to trade through the IC while insolvent and repatriating profits as purported 'dividends' to strip the company of assets to the detriment of creditors; issuing false solvency declarations in the annual return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act 1987, sections 157 and 179: court-ordered compensation to creditors; mandatory winding-up; voidable disposition of assets; statutory strike-off with forfeiture of corporate assets to the Crown
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil liability for the full amount of the company's debts incurred during fraudulent trading; personal civil restitution orders against director estates; global asset freeze; imprisonment up to 5 years for fraudulent trading under Samoa's Companies Winding-Up Act and International Companies Act
